name: Silverleaf Balm
description: A prepared jar of Silverleaf Balm — the canonical Feywood healer's salve for wounds, bruises, and minor burns. Cool on contact, mild-scented.
narrative_effects: Supports field triage rolls for cuts, bruises, and burns.
A standard Vaelmere trade export; appears routinely in realm healers' kits through elven supply chains.
